nl: 课程排期（vue2 / Element UI）：查询有课程名称、授课教师（下拉数据来自 /api/teachers 接口）；表格展示课程名称、授课教师、教室、报名人数、状态；新增和编辑使用不同的弹窗——新增填课程名称、授课教师、教室，编辑在此基础上还能修改状态；支持新增、编辑、删除；「报名人数」列仅在有权限时可见，权限码 course:signup:view；界面要求国际化。
nlEn: Course scheduling (vue2 / Element UI): query by course name and teacher (the teacher dropdown data comes from the /api/teachers endpoint); the table shows course name, teacher, classroom, signup count, and status; add and edit use different dialogs — on add fill in course name, teacher, and classroom, and on edit you can additionally change the status; supports add, edit, and delete; the "signup count" column is visible only with permission, code course:signup:view; the UI requires i18n.
notes: vue2 目标 + 四维：i18n + apiParams(教师下拉) + dialogs(新增/编辑不同表单) + extPoints(列级 permissionValue)。permissionValue 任意模式/位置安全（无 warning/TODO），故本列无须 inTable 特殊处理。
